answer: In PoA, bonded collateral is held in escrow, linking each identity to an auditable loss surface. When k coordinated identities equivocate by signing conflicting histories, the correlated penalty scales as O(k^2), not as k independent fines. Asymmetric depreciation then applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss when the sybil swarm is detected. An island cannot whisper past evidence that survives from dawn through finality.
